title: Execution after a continuing step
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $P$ a finite program, and $c,c'$ configurations consisting of a program counter and an integer-indexed memory of $W$-bit words. If one step from $c$ continues at $c'$, then for every nonnegative integer $t$, executing $P$ from $c$ for $t+1$ steps gives the same result as executing it from $c'$ for $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: One step from c continues at c'
